finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the hardcoded strings exceed the buffer size of 15 characters
finding.assumptions: The hardcoded strings are attacker-controlled or can be manipulated to exceed the buffer size.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the record fields contain shell metacharacters
finding.assumptions: The printf function is used to execute shell commands, which is not the case here. However, if the output is used in a shell command later, this could lead to injection.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: If the filename contains shell metacharacters
finding.assumptions: The functions HP_CreateFile and HP_OpenFile are used to execute shell commands, which is not the case here. However, if the filename is used in a shell command later, this could lead to injection.
